import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'StichtagDatJahr': [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'Rasse1Text': ['Deutsche Dogge', 'Deutsche Dogge', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog'],
    'Rasse2Text': ['Labrador Retriever', 'Labrador Retriever', '', '', ''],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='StichtagDatJahr', y='AnzHunde', hue='KreisLang', ci=None)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Year and Kreis')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.legend(title='Kreis')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
